verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah

xrefs.text: Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
For God, who said, “Let light shine out of darkness,” made His light shine in our hearts to give us the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of David. Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness! You have relieved my distress; show me grace and hear my prayer.
‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;
Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.

verses.text: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.

xrefs.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
He had been instructed in the way of the Lord and was fervent in spirit. He spoke and taught accurately about Jesus, though he knew only the baptism of John.
For my eyes have seen Your salvation,
The LORD has bared His holy arm in the sight of all the nations; all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.

verses.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

xrefs.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
I will commemorate your name through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you forever and ever.
For Sheol cannot thank You; Death cannot praise You. Those who descend to the Pit cannot hope for Your faithfulness.

verses.text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah

xrefs.text: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
Again, it says: “Rejoice, O Gentiles, with His people.”
He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
Sing to the LORD a new song— His praise from the ends of the earth— you who go down to the sea, and all that is in it, you islands, and all who dwell in them.
They raise their voices, they shout for joy; from the west they proclaim the majesty of the LORD.

verses.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.

xrefs.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
So then, this is how you should pray: ‘Our Father in heaven, hallowed be Your name.

verses.text: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.

xrefs.text: I will give you rains in their season, and the land will yield its produce, and the trees of the field will bear their fruit.

God also told Moses, “Say to the Israelites, ‘The LORD, the God of your fathers— the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob— has sent me to you.’ This is My name forever, and this is how I am to be remembered in every generation.

“But this is the covenant I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares the LORD. I will put My law in their minds and inscribe it on their hearts. And I will be their God, and they will be My people.
Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
I will establish My covenant as an everlasting covenant between Me and you and your descendants after you, to be your God and the God of your descendants after you.

verses.text: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.

xrefs.text: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
Turn to Me and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
Brothers, children of Abraham, and you Gentiles who fear God, it is to us that this message of salvation has been sent.
With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
